synopsis.text: Black Panther explains Wakanda’s unique history to the FF. Famed for their reservoirs of the rare and near-indestructible metal Vibranium, Wakanda has secluded itself from civilization to protect their precious ores. The origin story of Black Panther, King of Wakanda!
The Black Panther shows the Fantastic Four why he need to probe his power. They join forces against the powerfull threat of Klaw.
